name: homechart
description: Homechart is a productivity application to manage your household data--budgets, tasks, recipes, and more. Homechart can run in your browser or on your Android and iOS devices via an app. Requires POSTGRESQL 15 database to be set up All data is stored in database

variables.name: homechart_app_adminEmailAddresses
variables.description: Comma separated list of email addresses that will have admin access

variables.name: homechart_app_baseURL
variables.description: Base URL of the Homechart instance

variables.name: homechart_app_signupDisabled
variables.description: Set to true to disable sign up, new accounts can be created using admin console

variables.name: homechart_database_uri
variables.description: Database URI to connect with. Format is postgresql://username:password@hostname/database

variables.name: homechart_smtp_fromAddress
variables.description: Required for SMTP, email address to send from

variables.name: homechart_smtp_hostname
variables.description: Required for SMTP, hostname of SMTP server

variables.name: homechart_smtp_password
variables.description: Required for SMTP, password of SMTP server

variables.name: homechart_smtp_port
variables.description: Required for SMTP, port of SMTP server

variables.name: homechart_smtp_port
variables.description: Required for SMTP, username of SMTP server

variables.name: homechart_webpush_vapidPrivateKey
variables.description: Required for web push, can be generated using `homechart generate-vapid`

variables.name: homechart_webpush_vapidPublicKey
variables.description: Required for web push, can be generated using `homechart generate-vapid`
